summary: The complete offline suite passes, but two independently reproduced cross-module defects prevent approval: successful recollection deletes a previously acquired full JD, and loading a stored record changes an explicitly unknown deadline into an assumed KST deadline.

important.title: Recollecting a listing card irreversibly discards the previously ingested full JD
important.evidence: save_collection passes fresh + existing to deduplicate_jobs. The first record wins every substantive field; only warnings, source_ids and provenance are merged. Provenance stores source_id/evidence/collected_at, not the previous description, questions or deadline values. Therefore a successful fresh card with description='' replaces a full-text detail record without retaining its text anywhere in jobs.json.

reproduction.type: Executed offline using the repository's reduced public NAVER fixtures; no network
steps: Parse tests/fixtures/collect-naver-first-page.json with parse_job_postings at https://recruit.navercorp.com/rcrt/loadJobList.do?firstIndex=0 and source_id='naver'. Select the card for annoId=30005289.
Parse tests/fixtures/collect-naver-detail.html with parse_job_postings at that card's detail URL. Both records have the matching title '[NAVER] 보안 부문 경력 채용'. Mark their evidence.kind='test_fixture'.
In a temporary directory under TMPDIR, call save_collection with the detail record. Then call save_collection with a robots_denied result containing jobs=[]; confirm the description survives.
Call save_collection again with the matching listing card. Read jobs.json, and call prepare_application on the resulting record with an empty profile and a new temporary packet directory.

important.user_impact: The normal collect -> ingest detail -> collect refresh workflow destroys acquired application evidence. Subsequent preparation gets an empty JD and ranking loses its JD keyword input. Retaining a provenance URL/timestamp is not retention of the acquired text, which may no longer be accessible later.
important.required_resolution: Use a non-destructive observation merge: preserve full/detail text and its own provenance when a new observation is only a listing card, and retain conflicting field observations rather than silently discarding them. Do not mislabel preserved old text as newly fetched. Add an integration regression covering collect -> ingest -> collect -> prepare. No implementation change was made by this reviewer.

important.title: load_jobs reinterprets explicitly unknown deadlines and invents a timezone after collection
important.evidence: The collector deliberately stores deadline=None when normalization would require guessing, overriding make_job's permissive interpretation. load_jobs validates persisted records by calling make_job again; a None deadline causes make_job to parse deadline_raw and assume Seoul. This silently reverses the collector's safety decision while keeping the warning that the deadline could not be normalized.

reproduction.type: Executed with explicitly synthetic offline JSON-LD; no network
steps: Build a script[type='application/ld+json'] containing @type='JobPosting', title='OFFLINE timezone test', hiringOrganization.name='Fixture company', description='Synthetic review fixture, not a real job.', validThrough='2026-09-29T10:00:00', url='https://example.com/jobs/timezone-fixture'.
Call parse_job_postings on the script, set evidence.kind='test_fixture', and persist the returned record with save_collection into a temporary jobs.json.
Compare the raw JSON record with load_jobs(path)[0]. Evaluate deadline_state for both at now='2026-09-29T02:00:00Z'.

observed.warning_retained_in_both: Deadline could not be normalized without guessing; preserve deadline_raw.

important.user_impact: Commands that load saved jobs, including ranking, preparation and reporting, can present an uncertain deadline as a definite KST deadline or expired job even though acquisition explicitly refused to infer it. Recollection also loads existing records, so a later save can persist the invented value.
important.required_resolution: Distinguish constructing an observation from validating/deserializing a persisted observation. Preserve an explicit unknown normalized deadline on round-trip; do not infer it again from raw text without new evidence. Add parser -> save -> load/rank/report regression coverage for timezone-ambiguous deadlines. No implementation change was made by this reviewer.
